QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_HAVE_ASM` is defined. It is on by default and can be turned off by commenting it out (`mbedtls_config.h:32-52`). - The compiler defines `__GNUC__`, and it is not armcc5.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says asm use requires MBEDTLS_HAVE_ASM plus compiler macros, but never states that MBEDTLS_CT_ASM is a derived macro rather than a configured one.
